snippet.title: A Solitaire Mystery - Steam Release Trailer
snippet.description:
A Solitaire Mystery is coming to Steam on July 9th! This release adds 7 new solitaires, new music, polish, quality-of-life updates and bugfixes. The update will also be available on Itch.io. Note that this update will increase the price of the game USD $10.
Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3743220/A_Solitaire_Mystery/
Buy on Itch: https://hempuli.itch.io/a-solitaire-mystery

A Solitaire Mystery is a collection of 30 unusual solitaire cardgames, ranging from somewhat standard ruleset playable with a traditional deck of cards to mysterious experimental takes on the genre and funky reimplementations of other games in solitaire form.

Music composed by Hazelstorm: https://hazelstorm.bandcamp.com/album/a-solitaire-mystery-ost
The trailer features guest solitaires from Hazelstorm, Kusane Hexaku and Lennard "X_Sheep" Sprong.
Made using Löve2D.
